Subject: Post-demo commitments + legal redline roster and turnarounds

Hi Lena — thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we stay tight on the MAP milestones: 

1) Goal & target close: Pilot agreement signed, target close 2027-06-15 (internal SLA: 6 weeks).
2) Legal milestone: MSA/DPA redlines. Anthem to send initial redlines by Wed 5/5; Redwood to provide annotated responses and counter-redline plan within 48 hours of receiving them.
3) Owners: Anthem legal (Lena / Alex) -> submit redlines; Redwood legal lead (Ben) -> primary reviewer; Sales (me) -> coordinate prioritization; Marissa (CS) -> confirm pilot success criteria for SOW/SLA section.
4) Dependencies: procurement PO (Procurement Team) and security questionnaire (if changes to data handling are requested).
5) Deliverables this week: attached MAP draft v1 (sheet tabbed by milestone) and a redline stub we use for routing.

Ask: Can you confirm Anthem will send redlines by EOD Wed 5/5? If not, what date should we expect? Once we receive, Ben will target a 48-hour turnaround for initial legal responses; flag any items that require exec approval and we’ll escalate.

I copied Ben and Marissa to make ownership explicit. If helpful we can set a 30-minute redlines triage call as soon as Anthem shares them.

Thanks,
Soojin
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 20270503-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (MAP milestones spreadsheet), redlines-msa-anthem-annotated.pdf (routing stub)

Thanks Soojin — great demo, appreciate the clear MAP. Confirming timelines from our side:

- Legal will aim to send consolidated redlines by Thu 5/6 COB ET (Alex and I will own).
- Procurement will review pricing and send PO outline; likely need 1 week after legal signoff.
- Security may ask for a short call if there are DPA-specific questions; I’ll flag immediately.

We prefer a small triage call rather than back-and-forth email for anything > 3 substantive clauses changed. Thu morning works for a 30-min slot — I’ll hold 10:00–10:30 ET pending redlines.

Lena / team — thanks for the clear ask. For the SOW/SLA pilot metrics I propose we commit to the following two measurable criteria for the pilot period: 

1) Average p95 inference latency <= 750ms for typical 512-token requests (measured on Redwood Dedicated infra).
2) Monthly availability >= 99.5% during pilot windows (excluding scheduled maintenance).

If Anthem agrees, I’ll add these to the MAP SOW tab and Ben can map the SLA clause language to the redline.

Soojin — I’ll also create a short decision log in the MAP to record any clause exceptions and exec approvals so we don’t lose thread context.

Marissa
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
